description: This file defines the 'Container' class implementing a dependency injection container optimized for Drupal, compatible with Symfony's DI container, managing services, parameters, and their instantiation.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: A dependency injection container class optimized for Drupal, compatible with Symfony, managing service instantiation, parameters, and service definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the container with a given array of definitions, enforcing the machine_format requirement.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a service by ID, creating it if necessary, handling aliases, circular references, and invalid references.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets shared services, allowing the container to recreate services upon next request.

methods.name: createService
methods.description: Creates a service instance from its definition, handling arguments, factory methods, properties, and configurators.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a service instance in the container by ID.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a service or alias exists in the container.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value by name, throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter value, only if container is not frozen.

methods.name: initialized
methods.description: Checks if a service has been instantiated.

methods.name: resolveServicesAndParameters
methods.description: Resolves arguments representing services or parameters into actual instances or values.

methods.name: getAlternatives
methods.description: Provides similar key alternatives based on Levenshtein distance and containment.

methods.name: getServiceAlternatives
methods.description: Provides alternative service IDs for a given ID.

methods.name: getParameterAlternatives
methods.description: Provides alternative parameter names for a given name.

methods.name: getServiceIds
methods.description: Returns all service IDs including the container itself.
